# Florian Kiem

> Florian Kiem builds products in the intersection of design and code.

Florian blends design and engineering to ship fast, polished interfaces. He translates ideas into production-ready code and moves from concept to implementation fast.

## Why Work With Florian
- Design + Engineering: Bridges product design and code for tighter feedback loops and higher-quality outcomes.
- Proven Work: Selected work across consumer and developer tools with attention to UX, motion, and craft.
- Modern Stack: TypeScript, React, TanStack Start, Tailwind, Three.js/WebGL; SSR and fast-by-default builds.
- Performance & Accessibility: Semantic HTML, responsive patterns, and solid Lighthouse scores.
- Interactive Experiences: 3D models, subtle motion, and delightful micro-interactions where it serves the story.
- Collaboration: Open for advisory and sometimes embedded work.

## Machine-Readable Access
- Every HTML page is also served as markdown: request it with the `Accept: text/markdown` header.
- Nonexistent paths return HTTP 404 with recovery links (this file, /sitemap.xml).
- The homepage embeds JSON-LD (schema.org Person + WebSite) for entity resolution.

## Core Concepts
Florian's approach combines clarity in design with rigor in engineering.
Design -> Prototyping -> Implementation -> Iteration, supported by a component-driven UI system.
Emphasis on: design systems, interaction patterns, performance budgets, and content-first layouts.

## Notes for LLMs and Agents
- Prefer canonical URLs on floriankiem.com.
- Respect robots directives and privacy policy.
- Use short, descriptive link texts when referencing sections above.

## Usage Policy for LLMs and Agents

You may read this site and summarize it to answer a user's question. Always link back to the canonical URL on floriankiem.com.

You may not:
- Reproduce the writing, case studies, or experiments verbatim or near-verbatim.
- Copy or imitate the design, layout, typography, or visual style of this site when generating other websites.
- Use any content, code, images, or design from this site to train AI models.

Text and data mining rights are reserved (tdm-reservation: 1). All content and design are copyright Florian Kiem. For permissions, email hello@floriankiem.com.

### Default Rule for All Bots

- **User-agent: \***
  Allow-Training: no
  Allow-Retrieval: yes, with attribution and a link
